{{Top|leg}}
'''Blackout lights''' were an emergency lighting system aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. They used a minimal amount of energy, so they were undetectable by [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was equipped with blackout lights.
